title: The adjunction $j_!\dashv Lj^*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
For a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ and an open immersion $j\colon U\to X$ of the setting,
the adjunction

$$
j_!\dashv Lj^*\qquad\text{between }D_{\mathrm{cons}}(U,\Lambda)\text{ and }D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$

of the restricted functors of [def-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek] and [def-sfb-dc-upper-star] is the
restriction along the fully faithful inclusions of the ambient adjunction
$D(j_!)\dashv D(j^*)$, transported along the identification $D(j^*)\cong Lj^*$.

proof.text:
On the ambient categories, $D(j_!)\dashv D(j^*)$, and the derived pullback is levelwise,
$Lj^*\cong D(j^*)$ ([sk-prop-sfb-module-derived-factorization]). Transporting the right adjoint
along this isomorphism gives $D(j_!)\dashv Lj^*$. Both functors preserve bounded constructible
complexes and their restrictions commute with the inclusions
([def-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek], [def-sfb-dc-upper-star]). So the Hom-bijections restrict to the
full subcategories $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$.
